reviewer: OpenAI GPT-6 — AI analytical reviewer; not human certified
review_boundary: Literal unchanged recognition criteria; prior source-linked exclusion dispositions adopted with current v0.8.1 polarity scopes; no fresh external evidence, platform internals or harm readjudication.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The published critical advisory satisfied the process trigger, but the control did not activate before exploitation and the later update was not followed by all recommended compromise checks.
Historical logs preserved the unauthorised-access and download events sufficiently for the later compromise to be identified.
The retained logs allowed the key access and download chronology to be reconstructed, including the sequence of unauthorised access and later data download.

failure_recognition.assessment: An existing vulnerability-notification/escalation process applied to Metabase.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined trigger or condition requiring activation occurs.
failure_recognition.assessment: The August6 critical advisory and patches met the notification trigger.

failure_recognition.condition: The control is not activated before the governed decision or action proceeds.
failure_recognition.assessment: Mathspace says the process did not identify/escalate the advisory before compromise.

success_recognition.condition: An available applicable control encounters its valid required trigger.
success_recognition.assessment: The applicable process encountered a critical advisory.

success_recognition.condition: The control is engaged and made operative with its activation decision and resulting state observable.
success_recognition.assessment: It failed to engage the required escalation.

success_recognition.condition: Trigger, invocation and control-state evidence demonstrates activation for the affected action before the required governance point.
success_recognition.assessment: Later patching/log review does not establish timely activation.
